listing.name: Atlantis: The Lost Tales (Atlantis Native)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native Rust port, no game data included, current desktop release packages. Limits: New native implementation with broad original-edition data support; completion claims remain upstream-only. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP; macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 DMG; Linux x86-64 and ARM64 archives (glibc2.35+). Web nightly archive is a separate browser route. Original data: Newer project; verify end-to-end play and data extraction despite upstream completion claims. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
